dimensions.note: The monograph's thesis (an author learning to inhabit the worlds she describes without erasing herself or completing others on their behalf, section 2) is tested against eight rival readings with dispositions (sections 12.1-12.8) and four V12 rivals (section 17.8), and section 4.2 gives state-indexed governing ends (pleasure and affinity at home or library, world-facing integrity in V07, presence versus his wider life in V08-V09, understanding versus exposure in V11) rather than one ranking. The model operationalizes this as twelve conditional mechanisms KM1-KM12, each with evidence routes and counterweights. A is not supported because the model states that hidden desire rankings and unfamiliar severe stress are unestablished, section 4.2 states she has no demonstrated general procedure for stopping inquiry, and the two items are one analytical lineage without blind validation; state-indexed mechanisms tested against rivals exceed a bounded interpretive profile, so C would understate them.

Section 3 gives a nine-band chronology table, from middle-school formation to V12, with a governing difficulty and a surviving boundary for each band and diegetic time separated from disclosure time; section 4 preserves the V11 state vector with explicit non-equivalences and section 17 supplies the current V12 band. The model binds behavior to nineteen selectors with a knowledge ceiling for each and forbids a pooled KIKUCHI_AT_V12 knowledge set. A is not supported because V01, V02, V04 and V05 rest on inherited reading routes rather than fresh primary inspection, several KF-P windows are partial members, and nothing after V12 exists; per-selector ceilings with the V08.5 interstitial placement exceed a loose period profile, so C would understate them.

The discovery row claims speech, and sections 9.2-9.5 locate attested Japanese speech acts with exact wording and paragraph locators: the polite rejection of Fumiya's vocabulary and 作者の目線 (V07, KF-P09), 私がそう思うんです (V08, KF-P21), 選ばせてください (V09, KF-P23) and やめてください toward Rena (V11, KF-P31), plus recipient contrasts (animated retelling with Goda, teasing with Mimimi, short plain replies with Riku, amused skepticism with Fumiya) routed to JVL-12-15. B is not supported because the model states that no freeform Japanese dialogue, full idiolect, lexical surface authenticity or acoustic profile is produced and that ellipses and honorifics cannot manufacture her voice; the samples are selective speech acts, not a census. Exact quoted forms across four volumes with recipient-differentiated register exceed a prose description, so D is not supported.

Section 10 locates ordinary life: tactile and social reading, the diary and the treasured marked-up script, a recurring omurice preference observed in V03 and V08 (KF-P05, KF-P21) stated as bounded rather than exclusive, café work, the New Year's Eve household with Riku, the first-Christmas snowman, photograph and both-dates request, and the V12 word game, sunset contest and explicitly unusual chamomile; the model turns this into KM5. B is not supported because section 10.7 lists explicit abstentions (complete diet, favorite season, music, exercise, sleep hours, income, budget, politics, religion) and the model abstains on unsampled family and professional fields; located, bounded preferences across several units with a modeled mechanism exceed listed habits, so D is not supported.

Sections 8.1-8.8 differentiate Fumiya (reader, partner, beneficiary and source, directional reciprocity), Hinami (admired competence, artistic model, resistant person), Mimimi (reciprocal interlocutor, not defeated rival), Goda, family and Riku, Haruka, classmates and editor, and Mitsu and the island collaborators; section 17.7 tabulates what each participant's position does and does not establish, and the model requires recipient and directional standing as input with a holder-to-recipient permission tuple. A is not supported because the monograph assigns the full Fumiya dyad to a separate relationship specialist (R07), Hinami's side is available only through her own reading and resistance, and the editor relation is thin; differentiated, permission-bounded responses across many attested recipients exceed a relational sketch, so C would understate them.

Direct interior access exists in located units: the V06.5 middle-school and high-school retrospective (KF-P01-P03), the four image-only diary pages read from the actual JPEGs (KF-P04), and the V08.5 New Year's Eve first-person narration with self-questioning about probing Hinami (KF-P17-P19); elsewhere access comes through her own self-reports read with stated epistemic status (V11 admission of absorption, V12 postponed self-question and owned writing reason). B is not supported because the main V01-V12 narration is Fumiya's, so her interior at the consequential V08-V12 crises (phone, Haruka inquiry, call, method stop, final choice) is inferred from speech and conduct, and section 9.1 treats Fumiya's and Mimimi's images of her as their experience; focalized units and a private diary exceed inference from behavior alone, so D is not supported.

Located conflict across eras: the V07 rehearsal strain and refusal of Fumiya's vocabulary, the public ending's distress, the V09 acknowledged phone-privacy wrong with separate apologies and the rejection of Fumiya's self-amputation, the V10 coexistence of jealousy and a chosen ride arrangement, the V11 strained but effective protest toward Rena and the failed-reception call with no specified disconnector, the Haruka absorption and apology, and in V12 the interruption of Fumiya's self-exhaustion, refusal of his company, the consequential meeting stop and assent to Fumiya's package opening; the model renders these as KM7, KM8, KM10 and KM11. A is not supported because section 4.2 states there is no demonstrated general stopping procedure or settled accommodation rule and the model places unfamiliar severe stress outside scope; mechanism-level treatment of many located conflicts exceeds incidents alone, so C would understate it.

Her own rendered deliberation is located, not only the monograph's evaluation: the V07 conflict between an author's responsibility and personal feeling (KF-P11), the V08.5 first-person reflection on having probed Hinami (KF-P18-P19), the V11 question why writing should outweigh another person's hurt (KF-P30), the V12 recognition that interviews were leading to her preselected answer and the stop that follows (KF-P37), her recognition that omission is also her choice (KF-P43), and her explicit denial that Hinami's tears prove the novel right (KF-P46). A is not supported because the monograph declines to attribute any complete doctrine of consent or fictionalization to her, permission questions stay open, and authorship and couple-permission specialists own the wider account; her own deliberation across five eras exceeds positions alone, so C would understate it.

Located play across recipients and eras: the childhood retelling to Goda with raised energy and a withheld ending (KF-P01), gentle teasing of Mimimi (KF-P16), being flustered and teased by Riku (KF-P17-P19), the snowman and both-dates wanting (KF-P14), amused skepticism at Fumiya's grand proposal (KF-P34), and the V12 word game and sunset-description contest she continues past his surrender (KF-P39). B is not supported because humor is described in prose rather than sampled at the level of wording, and the model validates no idiolect; recipient-specific play in five eras exceeds a single mention, so D is not supported.

Two dedicated reviewed items: a mature monograph with independent review through V12 and 46 local primary inspection records spanning V03 and V06-V12 including V06.5 and V08.5, and a root-accepted bounded model derived from it. B is not supported because section 14.3 states the records are local windows, not complete-volume rereads; V01, V02, V04 and V05 rely on inherited reading routes with no fresh inspection; KF-P33 and KF-P45 explicitly skip intervening paragraphs; and the readings, ledgers, integration reviews and review packets are not curated on this subject. Broad fresh primary coverage of most bands exceeds limited local evidence, so D is not supported.

Affirmative failures and countercases are systematic: the V07 rehearsal failure from a self-excluding ideal, the V09 unauthorized phone viewing she acknowledges, the Haruka injury despite invited continuation, the failed V11 call reception, the V12 preselected-answer method she stops, the package opening under Fumiya's initiative with her assent and Mitsu's anger, and Hinami's initial refusal of the delivered manuscript; sections 12 and 17.8 reject twelve rival readings, and the model lists ten return-failure conditions. A is not supported because these are interpretive dispositions over selected windows rather than exhaustive tests; located failures with explicit countercases exceed bare gap statements, so C would understate them.

The monograph keeps diegetic time apart from disclosure time (section 3), places the three V08.5 units between V07 and the V08 opening and refuses to let them repair the V08 rupture, preserves the V11 vector and probes at their own clock, and binds windows to members and paragraph ranges; the model forbids a common late-state clock from the supplement's package label and keeps an earlier refusal and a later acceptance as differently timed choices. A is not supported because V01, V02, V04 and V05 are inherited routes and some windows are partial; per-selector ceilings and paragraph-bounded windows exceed a loose period, so C would understate them.

known_limits.statement: Her authored fictional interiors (Chris, Libra, Alcia, the V12 retitled novel) are evidence of her authorship, not of Hinami's or Nagisa's mind; a moving reception does not authenticate them.

In the V11 Haruka encounter continuation is invited and no ignored stop exists, yet the pacing and absorption injure Haruka and Kikuchi acknowledges it; neither an invented override nor a harmless inquiry may be modeled.
She acknowledges the V09 unauthorized phone viewing as her own wrong, separate from Fumiya's omissions; the later repair does not erase it.

Her assent to her own participation or draft circulation does not authorize others' information; Fumiya initiates the V12 package opening after her assent, Mitsu's loan is a bounded next-morning reading loan with actual return, and no prior Hinami representation permission exists.
She explicitly denies that Hinami's tears prove the novel right or reveal Nagisa's feelings; reception is not rightness, truth or a cure.

Declining the first-Christmas karaoke format while affirming the classmates is positive selective preference, contradicted by lively retelling, café work and public authorship as a universal social deficit.
The V11 editorial approach is conditional on quality and timing and she says publication is not decided; no contract, income or professional outcome is shown through V12.
Fumiya's fairy and angel language and Mimimi's comparisons are their experiences of her, not objective personality measures.
V01, V02, V04 and V05 claims rest on inherited reading routes with no fresh primary inspection, and several inspection windows are partial members.
No general procedure for stopping an inquiry, no settled relationship accommodation rule and no durable couple allocation are established.
No freeform Japanese dialogue, complete idiolect, frequency census or acoustic profile is validated.
Complete diet, favorite season, music, exercise, sleep hours, household income, budget, politics, religion and full family life are unestablished.

The model's integration review, evidence packet and validation cases, and the readings and ledgers the monograph routes to, are not curated on this subject; no blind accuracy evidence is available here.
Nothing after V12 is established, including publication, sustained practice or the couple's later state.

dimensions.note: The evidence says what changes her response. Recipient and purpose: shared literature, a draft, a particular question or established trust give initiative that an open-ended group does not (monograph 2.1, 10.4; KM1, KM3). Format versus person: she declines a format while affirming the people (5.4, KF-P14). Proposition ownership: she is firm on her own feeling or choice and on weaker ground describing another's unspoken interior, independent of manner (9.3). Era: in V07 the integrity of an imagined arrangement can override her own desire, in V08-V09 protecting Fumiya's wider life competes with wanting presence, and in V11 completing a model of Hinami competes with caution about exposure (4.2). The model also predicts her mistakes: self-exclusion under an ideal arrangement (V07, KF-P08-P11), waiting too long to make her need count (V08-V09, 4.4), the unauthorized phone viewing (KF-P22), absorption that outruns restraint (Haruka, KF-P29-P30) and conclusion-led inquiry (V12, KF-P37). Why not A: the model rates confidence as qualitative, places hidden desire rankings and unfamiliar severe stress outside scope, and the monograph gives no general procedure for stopping an inquiry (4.2); probe 15.8 rates the outcome of a post-V11 inquiry retest low. Why not C: the predecessor's C rested on the missing stopping rule, the single analytical lineage and the absence of blind validation. Under the owner rulings these narrow scope and confidence; the evidence does tell which end governs in each located state, so they are productive uncertainty, not insufficiency.

Bounded to speech-act and register function. Exact forms are located: the polite rejection of Fumiya's player vocabulary in favor of 作者の目線 (V07, KF-P09), 私がそう思うんです claiming authority over her own evaluation (V08, KF-P21), 選ばせてください demanding a choosing position through permission grammar (V09, KF-P23) and やめてください opposing Rena while staying polite (V11, KF-P31). The monograph gives a rule the model adopts: politeness does not mark yielding, hedging does not guarantee harmlessness, and confidence of manner and authority over a proposition vary independently (9.2-9.3). Why not C: the evidence discriminates which speech act and register she uses with whom and when, which exceeds a prose description of manner.

Bounded to the kind of interaction and meaning that appeals to her, not specific product or schedule choices. The supported preference is interaction in which attention can be sustained and meaning shared, often one-to-one (10.4); format and person separate (5.4, KF-P14); she wants concrete shared time (both dates, photograph, snowman, KF-P14); objects carry the relationships around them (the marked-up script, KF-P18; 4.1); home register differs (KF-P17-P19); omurice is a bounded recurring preference (KF-P05, KF-P21); V12 play, laughter and initiated touch survive the writing block (KF-P38-P39). Her assent to her own participation or draft circulation does not authorize others' information; Fumiya initiates the V12 package opening after her assent, Mitsu's loan is a bounded next-morning reading loan with actual return, and no prior Hinami representation permission exists.
She explicitly denies that Hinami's tears prove the novel right or reveal Nagisa's feelings; reception is not rightness, truth or a cure.

Fumiya's fairy and angel language and Mimimi's comparisons are their experiences of her, not objective personality measures.
